AboutHAWKI_Info:
Access to Artificial Intelligence for All University Members

With GPTalk, all university members have easy access to generative Artificial Intelligence (AI). The goal is to promote the integration of AI into everyday work and teaching processes while creating an open space for exchange, reflection, and new forms of collaboration. This enables an internal university dialogue about the opportunities and challenges of using AI.

Didactic Support and Guidance

The offering is also intended to provide didactic support by helping users better understand how large language models work. In various areas, helpful tips on effective prompts (text inputs) are provided to enable targeted and efficient use of the technology’s potential.

This offering is based on HAWKI, an open-source project developed at the Interaction Design Lab of the University of Applied Sciences and Arts (HAWK) in Hildesheim.

Reg_SL4_T:
You always log in with your Hohenheim user ID. The first time you log in, you create a personal datakey - a kind of additional password that is used to encrypt your chat messages before they are saved on our server.

When do you need the datakey?
In addition to your normal login, you will need the datakey when you log in on a new device or in a different browser. Your current device or browser automatically saves the Datakey so that you don't have to enter it every time. Without your Datakey, you will no longer be able to access your previous conversations.

Important: Save recovery code
At the end of this registration, you can download a recovery code for your Datakey. This is important in case you lose your Datakey.
Reg_SL5_T: Please note: Your chats are secure and fully encrypted. However, you will no longer be able to access your previous conversations without your data key. Therefore, keep your Datakey safe and protect it from access by third parties.
Reg_SL6_T: With this recovery code, you can restore your data key if you forget or lose it. Download your code onto your device and store it in a secure location.
